Usage: gaia search lkm [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Search Bohrium LKM shared knowledge.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ docs        Print LKM API documentation links.                               │
│ knowledge   Search LKM paper knowledge items.                                │
│ reasoning   Search reasoning chains, or fetch them for one claim with        │
│             --claim-id.                                                      │
│ nodes       Batch-fetch LKM node record detail.                              │
│ package     Fetch an LKM paper package candidate.                            │
│ references  Look up paper references and cited-by lists.                     │
│ feedback    Submit LKM service/data feedback.                                │
│ auth        Manage the LKM access key (login / status / logout / rotate).    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:
 gaia search lkm knowledge "solid state battery dendrite suppression"
 gaia search lkm package --paper-id <paper_id>
 What you have:
 claims, questions, or abstracts by topic/wording  ->  knowledge
 a similar argument, derivation, or experiment     ->  reasoning <query>
 a numeric paper ID from those hits ->  package, references
 any global gcn_... / node id       ->  nodes
 a conclusion gcn_... with has_reasoning=true      ->  reasoning --claim-id
 a local PDF                        ->  gaia extract
 Auth: every call needs a Bohrium access key. Run `gaia search lkm auth login`
 to set one up (or set GAIA_LKM_ACCESS_KEY / LKM_ACCESS_KEY).
 LKM (Large Knowledge Model) is Bohrium's shared-knowledge layer, built on a
 subset of the Gaia language: it integrates, curates, retrieves, and reasons
 over published structured knowledge. It is not Gaia's local IR, not a Gaia
 knowledge package, and not a generic graph API.
 Search surfaces: `knowledge` retrieves paper knowledge items, including
 conclusion claims, weak-point / highlight claims, problems, and open
 questions. `reasoning` retrieves reasoning chains and workflows. `package`
 fetches the per-paper graph that `gaia pkg add` can materialize as a local
 dependency. `references` looks up bibliographic forward references and reverse
 cited-by lists for papers already identified by id or DOI. `feedback` reports
 LKM service/data issues.
 Configured indexes: bohrium (default). Set GAIA_LKM_INDEX_<NAME>_URL to add a
 named LKM index.
 API docs: https://s.apifox.cn/<UUID4>
 Endpoint links: gaia search lkm docs
 Exit codes: 0 ok / 1 business error / 2 transport / 3 no key / 4 bad args.
 Note: the `score` field returned by `knowledge` / `reasoning` is a retrieval
 ranking signal, not a probability — do not pass it to Gaia priors.
